name: DisconfirmAI
tagline: Investment research that looks for the evidence against your thesis first
description: DisconfirmAI is an investment research and reading platform. Before you get confident about a stock or a thesis, it helps you look for the evidence that could prove you wrong. It has a daily reading feed built from public sources, deep research on filings and financial data, a radar that scans for changes you set conditions for, a place to write down your own investment framework, and an AI 100 list with industry maps. It is free to start on the web in English and Chinese.
